newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-SELES SLAMS SPIRLEA TO REACH OAKLAND FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SELES SLAMS SPIRLEA TO REACH OAKLAND FINAL.

text.p: Top-seeded Monica Seles breezed into the final of the Bank of the West Classic with a 6-3 6-3 victory Saturday over Romanian Irina Spirlea.
Seles, a two-time winner of this event, showed her dominance early, winning the first two games at love at Henry J. Kaiser Arena. Seles capped off the first set by breaking Spirlea at love again.
"I had a very big percentage of first serves," said Seles, poured in 75 percent of them. "I knew I had to do that because she's a good returner."
In the second set, Seles went up 3-0 and never faced a break point.
It was the third meeting between the two and Spirlea has yet to win a set against Seles.
"She served well and hit almost everything," said Spirlea, ranked 15th in the world. "When she won eight points in a row, I was thinking, Oh my God!"
Seles will meet the winner of a later semifinal between Brenda Schultz-McCarthy of the Netherlands and Switzerland's Martina Hingis.
